name: MonarchToggleGroup
title: ToggleGroup
wrapsNative: Toggle with MonarchToggleButtonStyle (.toggleStyle(.monarchButton)), in MonarchFlowLayout or VStackLayout
summary: Related toggle buttons in one named group, with any number on (a Set binding) or at most one on (an optional binding).
whenToUse: For a formatting toolbar, list filters or view options where several on/off choices belong together, or a toolbar choice where at most one is on.
whenNotToUse: When exactly one of a few views is always chosen, use Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented). For settings saved with a form, use Toggle or Picker in a Form. For more than about seven options, use a Menu or Picker.
api: init(_ title: String, selection: Binding<Set<Value>>, options: [MonarchToggleGroupOption<Value>], variant: MonarchToggleButtonVariant = .ghost, size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, axis: Axis = .horizontal)

init(_ title: String, selection: Binding<Value?>, options: [MonarchToggleGroupOption<Value>], variant: MonarchToggleButtonVariant = .ghost, size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, isRequired: Bool = false, axis: Axis = .horizontal)
MonarchToggleGroupOption.init(_ value: Value, label: String, systemImage: String? = nil, count: String? = nil, isIconOnly: Bool = false, isDisabled: Bool = false)

options.name: title
options.description: The name of the group, spoken by VoiceOver and not shown.

options.name: selection
options.description: The values that are on. A Set allows any number; an optional allows at most one.

options.name: options
options.description: The items in order: value, label, optional symbol, count, icon-only and disabled flags.

options.name: variant
options.description: ghost or outline: how items are drawn while off.

options.name: size
options.description: sm, md or lg for every item.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Single choice only: turning off the selected item is ignored, so one stays on.

options.name: axis
options.description: A row that wraps onto new rows, or a column.

states.name: off
states.description: An item is drawn as a toggle button that is off (no fill for ghost, a bordered surface for outline).

states.name: on
states.description: An item has the accent subtle fill, accent border and accent text; with Differentiate Without Colour it also shows a checkmark.

states.name: disabled
states.description: An item with isDisabled, or the whole group with disabled(_:), uses the disabled roles and does not respond.

appearance: Items are MonarchToggleButtonStyle toggles: on items use the accent subtle fill, accent border and strong accent text; off items use muted text, with the surface fill and default border for outline. Counts use the subtle text colour. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web ToggleGroup has one Tab stop with arrow keys, Home and End, and a loop option; on iOS each item is a separate VoiceOver element and keyboard focus follows the system, so those options are not offered. The web value "" for nothing selected is nil here. The web xs size is not offered on touch. Android covers toggle-group with a style on its theme instead of a type; iOS ships this wrapper because a group needs one selection binding for single and multiple choice.
accessibility: The group is a container whose label is the title.
Each item is a standard Toggle given to VoiceOver through MonarchToggleButtonStyle, read with its label and its on or off value.
An item with a count is read as the label, a comma and the count, such as "Open, 12".
An icon-only item is read by its label; the symbol is decorative.
With Differentiate Without Colour an on item also shows a checkmark, so the state is not colour alone.
Every item has a touch target of at least 44 by 44 points and scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: A horizontal group wraps onto new rows at large text sizes or with many items.
With isRequired and nothing selected, the first tap selects an item; after that one item stays on.
Values must be unique; they identify the items.
With a Set binding the order of the values is not kept; read them in the order of options.

examples.title: Multiple (formatting)
examples.template:
MonarchToggleGroup(
    {{label}},
    selection: $styles,
    options: [
        MonarchToggleGroupOption({{options.0.value}}, label: {{options.0.label}}),
        MonarchToggleGroupOption({{options.1.value}}, label: {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchToggleGroupOption({{options.2.value}}, label: {{options.2.label}}),
    ]
)
examples.code:
MonarchToggleGroup(
    "Text style",
    selection: $styles,
    options: [
        MonarchToggleGroupOption("bold", label: "Bold"),
        MonarchToggleGroupOption("italic", label: "Italic"),
        MonarchToggleGroupOption("underline", label: "Underline"),
    ]
)

examples.title: A view choice that always has one on
examples.code:
MonarchToggleGroup(
    "View",
    selection: $view,
    options: [
        MonarchToggleGroupOption("list", label: "List", systemImage: "list.bullet"),
        MonarchToggleGroupOption("board", label: "Board", systemImage: "square.grid.2x2"),
    ],
    variant: .outline,
    isRequired: true
)

examples.title: Filters with counts
examples.code:
MonarchToggleGroup(
    "Status",
    selection: $status,
    options: [
        MonarchToggleGroupOption("open", label: "Open", count: "12"),
        MonarchToggleGroupOption("closed", label: "Closed", count: "3"),
    ],
    size: .sm
)
